title: 2026 UK ETS free-allocation MMP monitoring and reporting QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and UK ETS regulators
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for installations: how to comply

facts.source_fact: Free-allocation installations must monitor activity levels.
Monitoring covers all sub-installations from 1 January to 31 December.
Monitoring must follow the approved MMP.
Written procedures can supplement the MMP.
facts.expected_handling: Keep supplementary procedures linked to plan.

facts.source_fact: Monitoring must also comply with the FAR.
Activity-level data collected through monitoring is used to produce the ALR.
UKETS13 addresses monitoring and reporting data required for free allocation and benchmark updates.
Significant MMP modifications require a permit-variation route.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat significant changes as simple notification.

facts.source_fact: Non-significant MMP modifications are notified to the regulator.
MMP data is free-allocation activity data, not a parcel emissions measurement.
